title: Least bonds over every side branch grow in proportion to nesting depth
claim: For every s >= 1, ceil(s/3)+1 <= L(s) <= ceil(s/2)+2 in the specified branching limit-only family. Eligible targets are either own distinction in the depth-s copy on the first branch. The minimum allows all three top ports and arbitrary finite support throughout the infinite family.
standard_statement: In the infinite ternarily recursive positive NAE instance of sample_5 line 11064, bound the minimum support size of a minimal non-shattered set connecting a root port and an own variable at ray depth s by positive linear functions of s.
prior_work: The finite-state ends theorem concerns top windows. The earlier ray program restricts supports. Leaf A gives a same-family exact finite-depth aggregate discrepancy. Finite-state forgetting by relation composition and a loose NAE chain are standard ingredients; their joint implication for this branching family is the new local result.

validation.status: Induction and extension proof read independently. Finite projections from the original recursive rule and the knotlab relation checks pass.
validation.independence: A separate mathematical reader checked the empty-group argument, supplied the shorter all-depth upper construction, and checked the freely chosen target control.

remaining_obligations: The exact least size at each depth and its asymptotic coefficient remain open.
Classification of other branching families and finite-flip sources at an infinite solution are separate questions.
foundation_claim_scope: Proper supports in one specified branching limit-only family. No prevalence or native-at-a-solution assertion.
